caption: The drawing features a single spherical object centered within a rectangular frame that is outlined by a fine, dark line. The object appears to be a glass marble or similar sphere and is depicted with intricate color and shading. The surface of the sphere is mostly transparent and reflective, with swirls of white and reddish-brown curving lines running from the top to the bottom, creating a sense of depth and roundness. The background is a uniform, pale beige tone that gradually darkens towards the edges, and there are no additional objects or elements besides the centrally placed sphere. The artist's signature, "JOHN DANA," appears in small capital letters near the bottom right corner inside the frame.
title: Witch Ball
